snippet.title: DRIFT BOOM BOOM Pre-Alpha Trailer          🚗💥💥
snippet.description:
DRIFT BOOM BOOM is an upcoming Combat Racing Game
Add to your Steam Wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2826510

- DRIFT Your way around 40+ Race Courses, Story Mode, and the arcade-like Challenge Mode
- BOOM Use your winnings to Purchase Upgrades, Weapons, and precious Ammunition
- BOOM Crash and Blow Up the competition. Just keep an eye out behind you on the final lap!

Story Mode:
Follow the rookie Agent on her assignment to stop the Scum Lord in small-town Appalachia.

Local Multiplayer:
Plug in up to four controllers for Splitscreen Action.
Simple Controls means anyone can hop in!

Family Friendly!
Retro Cars!
Eurobeat Soundtrack!
Explosions!!!

Coming soon to Steam, and maybe also a game console near you.

🚗💥💥

Visit TeamKDGames.com for more info
